name: document-data-visualization-report
title: Data Visualization Report
description: A two-page A4 report that turns real business data into an executive signal, directly labeled charts, decisions, and a validation plan.

description_i18n.en: A two-page A4 report that turns real business data into an executive signal, directly labeled charts, decisions, and a validation plan.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 将真实业务数据组织为执行信号、直接标注图表、决策建议与验证计划的双页 A4 报告。

query.en: Use the Data Visualization Report to turn my real content into a polished, self-contained HTML document. Start from the embedded reference HTML, preserve its visual signature and A4 print contract, and do not invent facts.
query.zh-CN: 用「数据可视化报告」把我的真实内容做成一份精致、可独立打开的 HTML 文档。必须从内嵌参考 HTML 开始，保留视觉特征和 A4 打印契约，不要虚构事实。
